claim: On the 15-tile benchmark the published models were scored on, the shipped detector leads both metrics. The lead survives dropping the frames whose tiles informed its configuration, and does not survive dropping the specimens - n=2 there, which settles nothing either way.
caveat: Every competing arm is scored leave-one-FRAME-out, which penalises it for having a tunable parameter. v1.49.2 has no parameter fitted on these tiles, but 3 of the 9 frames and 5 of 7 specimens also appear in the 26-tile set used to choose its configuration, so the all-15 row is the favourable reading. And at n=15 nothing on this benchmark separated statistically in the first place.
